waypoints.name: Stuart Lake Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From US 2 on the west side of Leavenworth, turn south on Icicle Road and drive about 8.4 miles, then turn left onto the signed gravel Eightmile Road (FR 7601), crossing Icicle Creek and climbing a washboarded, potholed road. A Northwest Forest Pass is required.

waypoints.name: Cannon Mountain summit (NE Ridge route point)
waypoints.directions: Climb steep, bushy, loose burned slopes to the northeast ridge crest, then scramble southwest over big blocks, Coney Lake below to the east, about half a mile to a band of towers near 7,980 ft. Drop right (west) and traverse about 0.3 mile of loose ribs near 7,900 ft, climb the large loose gully beyond about 500 ft back to the crest, and walk south to the summit block, finishing by friction on its east side.
